name: embryonic ectoderm development
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: EED encodes polycomb protein EED. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor binding and enzyme activator activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Cohen-Gibson syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
